# catchment.school

> Free, independent school catchment-area checker. Find primary, secondary and sixth-form schools near a UK postcode, with capacity, admissions data, and a link to a search for the relevant council's admissions policy. Data sourced from the Department for Education's Get Information About Schools (GIAS) register under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

The site is not affiliated with any school, local authority or government body. Every figure is taken from published DfE or Ofsted data with the source named on the page.

This site is freely indexable by all major search and AI crawlers. Citations welcome. Please link back to the canonical page and attribute "catchment.school" as the source.

## Core

- [Find schools by postcode](https://catchment.school/postcode): UK postcode search returning every primary and secondary school nearby, with distance, current pupil numbers and admissions links.
- [Browse all 178 local authorities](https://catchment.school/council): Full A to Z index of every English and Welsh local authority, with school counts per LA.
- [Browse schools by town](https://catchment.school/area): Town-level aggregation of schools in England, with Welsh schools listed from GIAS.
- [Cardiff school catchment areas](https://catchment.school/council/cardiff/): Worked example showing the full LA-level page format.

## Guides

- [How school catchment areas actually work in 2026](https://catchment.school/guides/how-school-catchment-areas-work): Explains catchment as a tiebreaker (not a guarantee), oversubscription criteria, and how "as the crow flies" distance is measured.
- [Primary school catchment & admissions](https://catchment.school/guides/primary-school-catchment): Reception applications, in-year transfers, what to do if you've moved house after the deadline.
- [Secondary school catchment & admissions](https://catchment.school/guides/secondary-school-catchment): Year 6 to Year 7 transition, feeder schools, and a sober look at "tutor-proofing".
- [School admissions timeline 2026/27](https://catchment.school/guides/school-admissions-timeline): Application open/close dates, offer day, appeals deadlines for England.
- [How to appeal a school place](https://catchment.school/guides/how-to-appeal-a-school-place): Independent Appeal Panel process, grounds for appeal, and what to expect.
- [In-year admissions](https://catchment.school/guides/in-year-admissions): Mid-year transfers, fair-access protocols, and waiting lists.
- [School waiting lists explained](https://catchment.school/guides/school-waiting-lists): How councils rank waiting lists and how often they move.
- [Ofsted ratings explained](https://catchment.school/guides/ofsted-ratings-explained): Outstanding, Good, Requires Improvement and Inadequate: what each means and how reliable they are.

## About

- [Editorial policy](https://catchment.school/editorial-policy/): How the site sources, presents and corrects its data and guides.
- [About catchment.school](https://catchment.school/about): What the site is, where its data comes from and how to report a mistake.
- [Privacy policy](https://catchment.school/privacy)

## Data

- Sitemap index: https://catchment.school/sitemap-index.xml
- Schools sitemap (~27,000 schools): https://catchment.school/sitemap-schools.xml
- Source data: UK Department for Education, Get Information About Schools (GIAS), Open Government Licence v3.0.
- Coverage: schools in England, with basic listings for Welsh schools from GIAS (admissions, Ofsted and results figures cover England only). ~27,000 open primary, secondary, sixth-form, special and nursery schools.
- Updates: the source files are downloaded by hand when the DfE or Ofsted publish a new release. See https://catchment.school/methodology/ for each dataset's release and download date.
